visual_review.reviewer: AI assistant visual inspection; not an independent human review
visual_review.method: Rendered every page at 110 dpi and visually inspected all pages in three contact sheets, then full-page images for the first page, new development observations, public-base capture paragraph, and appendix tables.
visual_review.observations: No clipped text, overlap, missing glyphs or broken formulas observed. New provenance paths wrap within their table cells.

machine_check_refinement: Matched current citeproc bibitem syntax and case-insensitive first-page working-draft text; initial checker assumed a different anchor syntax and capitalization.
